data.summary: A vibrant cutout photo composition combining a realistic business owner portrait with playful, digital graphic overlays. The style balances professional and approachable visuals with a mix of organic photography and digital UI/card elements.
data.layoutRecipe: 1. Center-right: Main person photo, cropped in a freeform rounded mask; subject facing outward holding flowers. 2. Mid-left, partly overlaying the photo: Card UI containing headline (Recent invoices) and large currency/amount, with badge and illustrative icons overlapping. 3. Layered around and behind the primary photo: Scattered decorative digital graphic icons, badges, and coin/money illustrations. 4. Bottom layers: Visible setting of a modern florist environment, including vases with flowers, supporting the business context.

messages.text:
Both pass visual review. Here's the summary:

**Variant 1 — "Recent invoices"** (light blue background): A warm photo of a woman business owner sits center-right, with a white content card layered at bottom-left showing "Recent invoices / All paid" plus a navy-blue "Paid" chip. A navy bloom and a bloom-blue organic shape sit behind the photo, while a money-cycle illustration floats near the card and a performance-growth illustration adds energy top-right. A sparkle charm accents the bottom-right corner. Navy logo, bottom-left.

**Variant 2 — "Cash flow without the suspense"** (navy background): A candid photo of a man business owner is positioned center-right, with a white card at bottom-left carrying the headline and subhead plus a light-blue "Find out more" CTA. Light-blue bloom shapes frame the composition from behind, a finance-growth illustration sits near the card, and a business-task illustration adds visual interest top-right. A percent-discount charm sits near the card edge. Light-blue logo, bottom-left.

Both follow the reference's layered cutout-photo-with-card-overlay system, translated entirely into Xero's palette, type, blooms, illustrations, and charms — no copied elements.
